howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.description: Notifications can be set up not only for yourself but also for a group of friends or your own Telegram channel. Read the instructions:

tabs.label: Personal
steps: Open the [Mini App]({{botUrl}}) to add your favourite teams and the matches you care about
Done! You’ll get match alerts. To change the notification language or turn on more events, go to [settings]({{botSettingsUrl}})

tabs.label: Groups
steps: Send /group to the [bot]({{botChatUrl}}) or follow this [link]({{botGroupUrl}}) — it opens the group picker right away
Choose the group where you want to receive notifications
A button appears at the top of the app so you can configure alerts and pick teams for the group separately from your personal profile. Perfect time to add favourite teams, leagues, or matches
Done! Match alerts now reach not only you, but your friends in the group too

tabs.label: Channels
steps: Send /channel to the [bot]({{botChatUrl}}) or follow this [link]({{botChannelUrl}}) — it opens the channel picker right away
Choose the channel where you want to receive notifications
Give the bot permission to post messages
A button appears at the top of the app so you can configure alerts and pick teams for the channel separately from your personal profile. Perfect time to add favourite teams, leagues, or matches
Done! Match alerts now reach not only you, but your subscribers too

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Short answers grounded in what Football. LIVE ships today.

items.question: What is Football. LIVE?
items.answer: A Telegram football app. The bot sends real-time notifications, and the Mini App lets you browse the calendar, latest results, stats, and manage favourites.

items.question: Who is it for?
items.answer: For personal chats, Telegram groups, and Telegram channels.

items.question: Is personal use free?
items.answer: Personal use is free for now. Paid plans are only for groups and channels.

items.question: How do I connect a group?
items.answer: Open the [bot]({{botChatUrl}}), send /group, and pick a group where you want alerts and have admin rights. Then open the [Mini App]({{botUrl}}), switch to the group profile at the top instead of your personal one, and choose teams or leagues to follow.

items.question: How do I connect a channel?
items.answer: Open the [bot]({{botChatUrl}}), send /channel, and pick a channel where you want alerts and have permission to post messages. Then open the [Mini App]({{botUrl}}), switch to the channel profile at the top instead of your personal one, and choose teams or leagues to follow.

items.question: What is Chat Premium?
items.answer: A subscription for groups and channels that lets you favourite more than one league or team. It costs 49 Stars for 30 days.

items.question: What can I configure in notifications?
items.answer: In the Mini App you can toggle: goal, goal scorer, full-time, kickoff, half-time, second half, 15 minutes before, red card, and a short delay. Goals and full-time are on by default.

items.question: How do I stop personal alerts?
items.answer: Send /stop in Telegram (or use the unsubscribe path). You can reactivate later with /start or from the Mini App.

closingCta.heading: Set up in a couple of taps
closingCta.subheading: Open the bot and pick your favourite team — a couple of taps so you don't miss what matters.
